current: Two disjoint halves exist. (1) The event-contract-specific research capability the requirement names is fully built but orphaned: qip_prediction::scoring::{ScoredForecast::new, brier_score, market_brier_score, compare} (backend/crates/services/qip-prediction/src/scoring.rs:46,66,155,164,185,230) Brier-scores the platform's own probability against a resolved market's implied probability over a set of ScoredForecast records, and ScoredForecast::new refuses a market quote known after the platform's own probability was formed. That is a different point-in-time rule from the one the requirement's verification names: the verification asks that no *outcome* be read before its resolution became knowable, whereas ScoredForecast::new accepts any Final MarketResolution and never compares the resolution's own instant with an as-of clock -- there is no replay clock in the scoring path at all. It has zero callers outside its own crate (confirmed: `grep -rln "qip_prediction::scoring\|qip_prediction::market\|qip_prediction::oracle" backend --include=*.rs` matches only qip-prediction/tests). (2) A different, generic mechanism -- qip_prediction::resolution::{Proposition::new, ResolutionCriteria} -- IS reached from production: qip-kernel's REASON-stage thesis pipeline constructs a Proposition for every investment hypothesis it forms (backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/src/platform.rs:12432-12450) and grades it point-in-time in the LEARN stage (platform.rs:14403-14528), proven replay-safe by backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/tests/falsification.rs. But that pipeline forms propositions about generic market-data metrics, never an EventMarket or a prediction-market contract -- no event-contract fixture is anywhere in that path.
evidence: backend/crates/runtime/qip-kernel/src/platform.rs:12432 Proposition::new (generic thesis, not an event contract)
gap: qip-kernel never calls qip_prediction::scoring or constructs an EventMarket, so nothing today replays a research run 'over a fixture of historical event contracts and their resolutions' as the requirement's own verification describes -- the point-in-time replay machinery that exists is proven only for generic price-threshold theses.
